name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship (Graduate Taught)
amount: 50% or 100% tuition fee scholarship (limited number); renewed yearly if GPA ≥ 3.08
dlText: 31 Mar 2027 for most regions; 28 Feb 2027 for Middle East, Africa, Pakistan and South Asia (times not stated)
fields: UCD graduate taught programmes (not online, part-time, clinical or January-start)
note: Only for incoming students classed as non-EU for tuition fee purposes; you must hold an offer before applying. Results about seven weeks after each regional deadline.

name: Ireland Fellows Programme – Africa
host: Department of Foreign Affairs (Irish Aid) – Ireland Fellows Programme
amount: Full: tuition, flights, visa & residence-permit fees, insurance, accommodation (trimesters 1–2), living and settling-in allowances
dlText: Stage 1 closed 26 Jul 2026 (2027/28 intake; time not stated)
fields: Master's programmes from the Directory of Eligible Programmes (development-relevant fields)
note: Fully funded one-year master's for early/mid-career professionals; three-stage process via the Irish Embassy (Stage 1 Jun–Jul, Stage 2 Sep–Oct, interviews). Minimum work experience varies by country; some countries are by invitation only via Irish Aid partners.

name: Ireland Fellows Programme – Small Island Developing States (SIDS)

name: Teagasc Walsh Scholars Programme
amount: €25,000/year stipend + tuition fees up to €6,000/year (4 yrs PhD, 2 yrs research MSc)
dlText: Expected ~mid-Mar 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle, most projects closed 18 Mar 2026; time not stated)
tags: Fees above €6,000 not covered by Teagasc

eligibility.note: Apply to an advertised project; non-EU eligibility is not stated in the call – fees above €6,000/yr (e.g. non-EU rates) must be covered by the university. Confirm with the project supervisor.

fields: Agriculture, food science, environment, rural economy
note: PhD and Research Masters projects run jointly by Teagasc and universities; each advert lists its own deadline and requirements.
